title: A Rainy Weekend
description: Three short recordings about a rainy weekend: a boy and his mum, a weather report and a phone call.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Sam and Mum
parts.intro: You will hear Sam talking to his mum on a rainy day.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: It's raining again, Sam. We can't go to the beach.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: That's boring. What can we do inside?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: We could bake something, or you could paint a picture.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: I'd like to bake. Can we make chocolate biscuits?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: We don't have any chocolate, but we have lots of bananas. We could make banana cake.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: OK! And then can I watch a film?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Yes, after we clean the kitchen.

script.speaker: Sam
script.text: I'll find the flour and the eggs, Mum. Where's the big bowl?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: It's in the cupboard under the sink. Please be careful with the eggs.

parts.title: Part 2 · The weather
parts.intro: You will hear the weather report on the radio.

script.speaker: Mr Wood
script.text: Here is the weather for the weekend. On Saturday, it will rain all day, with a strong wind in the north. Please take an umbrella if you go out.

script.speaker: Mr Wood
script.text: On Sunday morning, it will still be cloudy, but the rain will stop at about noon.

script.speaker: Mr Wood
script.text: In the afternoon, we'll have some sunshine, and it will be warm, about eighteen degrees.

script.speaker: Mr Wood
script.text: That's good news for the football match in the park at three o'clock. Next week will be dry.

script.speaker: Mr Wood
script.text: So, remember your umbrella on Saturday and your sunglasses on Sunday. That's all for now.

parts.title: Part 3 · A phone call
parts.intro: You will hear Minh calling his friend Mai.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Hello, Mai. It's Minh. What are you doing today?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Nothing much. I'm reading my new book about dragons. And you?

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: I'm building a model ship with my brother. It's very hard!

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Cool! Would you like to come to my house tomorrow? We can play board games.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Yes, please! Is two o'clock OK?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Make it three o'clock. I have a piano lesson at two.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Fine. I'll bring my favourite game, the one with the dice.
